players.product: Supercapacitor cells (lead and snap-in type), modules and systems for AI data-center (AIDC) UPS and peak-power control

quarterly_data.signal: 2Q26 results (deck): revenue KRW 353 hundred million (QoQ 39.5% up) with an operating profit turnaround; table (KRW million): 2Q26 revenue 35,384, supercapacitor 33,520, of which AIDC 14,736 (1Q26 6,066; 242.9% of the prior quarter), hydrogen fuel cell 1,382, operating profit 498 (1Q26 -1,536), EBITDA 5,459. The company cites continued sales growth on a stable AIDC order base and wider supercapacitor demand beyond AIDC (automotive electronics, smart meters, home appliances). Notes: the factory fire caused partial loss of production facilities, and H1 non-operating expenses rose on the fire asset loss.
